title: OpenAI removes gpt-5.5-cyber-preview from the API on February 1, 2027
detail: A deprecation entry dated 2026-11-05 states that the gpt-5.5-cyber-preview model is deprecated and will be removed from the API on February 1, 2027. The listed replacement is not a named model but "the most capable cyber model available to you". The same day, the API changelog announced gpt-6-cyber. OpenAI's deprecations page says preview models may be retired with shorter notice than generally available models.
impact: Security teams calling gpt-5.5-cyber-preview lose it on February 1, 2027. The replacement depends on which cyber models the organization has been granted access to, so check access to gpt-6-cyber and re-test vulnerability workflows on it before the shutdown date.
